title: androsace constancei
intro: Androsace constancei, commonly known as Himalayan Rock Jasmine or Himalayan Starflower, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Androsace constancei include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory congestion, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its medicinal properties.
